title: Bosun Realm 28: Legacy Contract v1
description: Machine-readable delta schema contract for Legacy (Realm 28), extending Archetype Sovereign Vault and Universal Meta-Envelope with realm-specific payload attributes.

trust_ref.description: Reference identifier to legal trust or estate instrument.

living_will_cas.description: CAS hash or URN of the encrypted advance healthcare directive / living will.

executor_contact_urn.description: URN referencing the appointed executor contact.

durable_poa_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the durable power of attorney deed.
